explanation: The name comes from horse races run across country between church steeples, which riders used as landmarks. The Olympic event covers 3,000 metres, with seven water jumps.

claims.text: The 3,000 metres steeplechase includes a water jump as well as barriers.
The 400 m hurdles, the 110 m hurdles and the 10,000 m have no water jump.
The name steeplechase comes from cross-country horse races run from one church steeple to another.
The Olympic steeplechase is run over 3,000 metres with 28 barrier jumps and 7 water jumps.
